title: Greene County Bancorp, Inc. Reports Net Income of $8.9 Million for the Three Months Ended September 30, 2025, and Finalized Expansion Plans into Saratoga County
summary: CATSKILL, N.Y., Oct. 21, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Greene County Bancorp, Inc. (the “Company”) (NASDAQ: GCBC), the holding company for the Bank of Greene County and its subsidiary Greene County Commercial Bank, today reported net income for the three months ended September 30, 2025, which is the first quarter of the Company’s fiscal year ending June 30, 2026. Net income for the three months ended September 30, 2025, was $8.9 million, or $0.52 per basic and diluted share, as compared to $6.3 million, or $0.37 per basic and diluted share, for the three months ended September 30, 2024. Net income increased $2.6 million, or 41.7%, when comparing the three months ended September 30, 2025 and 2024.
